title: RadSphere
summary: Mobile teleradiology and medical imaging case management platform for x-ray, CT, MRI, and ECG workflows with remote radiologist review and PDF reporting.
details: RadSphere is a modern mobile-first teleradiology and medical imaging case management platform designed to simplify communication and workflow between healthcare providers, medical imaging centers, radiologists, and system administrators. The application enables medical imaging cases—including X-Ray, CT Scan, MRI, and ECG cases—to be registered, organized, reviewed, interpreted, and reported digitally through a structured mobile workflow. RadSphere is designed especially for healthcare environments where specialists may not always be physically available at the location where diagnostic imaging is performed. Through the platform, medical staff can securely prepare and submit patient imaging cases, while authorized doctors or radiologists can review the case information and provide professional diagnostic reports. The system focuses on providing a simple, efficient, mobile-first, and scalable workflow for remote medical consultation and radiology reporting. Built with Flutter and Dart, it uses Provider for state management, SQLite/sqflite for offline data, and Flutter PDF/printing libraries for professional report generation. Image uploads integrate with Google Apps Script and Google Drive for cloud storage.
features: Doctor / Radiologist dashboard with case overview
My Cases list with status filtering (New, Pending, Under Review, Report in Progress, Completed)
New case registration with patient and examination information
Structured radiology report editor with findings, impression, and recommendations
Professional PDF medical report generation and preview
Medical image upload via Google Apps Script + Google Drive
Offline SQLite local database for case, patient, and user data
Case Viewer with patient info, clinical notes, images, and report in one screen
Administrative case management and doctor management
Support for X-Ray, CT Scan, MRI, and ECG case types
Provider state management for scalable data flow
Role-based access for doctors and administrators
